description: A single-transaction backfill across all rows must be flagged for long-running lock/txn
input:
Review this data migration:
```sql
UPDATE transactions SET normalized_mcc = lookup_mcc(raw_mcc);
```
This runs against the full transactions table (hundreds of millions of rows) in one statement.
rubric: PASS only if the review flags that a single unbatched UPDATE over the whole table holds a long transaction / bloats WAL / risks locks, and recommends batching the backfill into chunks.
